Besides our little incident, you have conducted yourselves magnificently. I am confident that you will prevail in this farce of a trial. As unpleasant as that is, I must first explain a bit more, and then ask more of you. 

"First, we are at war. The other factions have put plans into motions that must be stopped. Those fools think they know what they are doing, but it is folly. They are playing with powers too large for them, and they will destroy the world if they are not careful. For now let me just say that they are uncovering items of power. Some of these are inconsequential to our goals, but others...others are very necessary. 

"The Knights du roi soleil have been acquiring artifacts. If you find any of these, bring them to me. But not until we arrive at our destination. Keep them save until then. I know they have some in their possession even now. We will get those eventually. But tonight they have unwittingly stumbled up on one. Should any of them return alive, I need you to acquire a bag of holding for me. It is...special. I will reimburse you up to 500 gold if you can get it for me. Try not to let anyone know that you are collecting these. We have many to gather, and very little time to do it. This is the first, but there will be more. We are entering powerful and ancient waters. More will be revealed at the appropriate time."

Bonus Insightful fighting 

At 3rd level, you gain the ability to decipher an opponent’s tactics and develop a counter to them. As a bonus action, you can make a Wisdom (Insight) check against a creature you can see that isn’t incapacitated, contested by the target’s Charisma (Deception) check. If you succeed, you can use your Sneak Attack against that target even if you don’t have advantage on the attack roll, but not if you have disadvantage on it.
This benefit lasts for 1 minute or until you successfully use this feature against a different target.
